---
title: "Normal Distribution of IQ"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

task <- "llnorm4"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

interval <- function(l, u) {
  sprintf("$(%s, %s)$", round(l, 2), round(u, 2))
}

hook(interval(.Lower, .Upper), c(.Lower, .Upper))

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  percentage <- sample(seq(10, 45, 5), 1)
  p <- round(percentage / 100, 2)
  mu <- 100
  sigma <- 15
  
  Q <- quote(search(llnorm4, llnorm4(p, mu, sigma), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(
  t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra
)
```

Question
========
Which is the IQ range that is symmetrical around the mean and includes `r percentage`% of the population ($\mu$ = 100, $\sigma$ = 15)?

```{r questionlist, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The range is calculated by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```

Meta-information
================
extype: schoice
exsolution: `r mchoice2string(t$correct, single=TRUE)`
exname: llnorm4
